text:
oliver: deploy-bot just flagged an inconsistency for release v7.1.0. Release notes mention `--edge-cache` but the binary fails on startup with unknown flag.

deploy-bot: Rule RN-155 triggered: release_notes_binary_mismatch. Suggested actions: pause, rollback to v7.0.3, or hotpatch.

ops-jen: Any user impact?

maya: No external alerts. QA saw a single canary exit: `Error: unknown option 'edge-cache'`.

qa-kevin: Metrics look clean; p95 +2% (noise). Auto-rollback not triggered.

ops-jen: Tradeoff: rollback fast (~12m) but fragments telemetry; hotpatch keeps continuity (~40-60m).

oliver: I'm leaning hotpatch since no customer impact. Plan: pause rollout, pin traffic to v7.0.3, branch from v7.1.0, reapply handler, tag v7.1.1, smoke, staged promote.

ops-jen: Running: `deployctl pause --release v7.1.0` -> paused. `deployctl traffic pin --to v7.0.3 --percent 100` -> applied.

maya: Hotpatch PR in progress. Will include changelog diff and link to revert.

support-lara: Drafting CSM note: "Paused rollout; hotpatch in progress; no customer impact observed."

qa-kevin: Staging build OK, smoke passes.

oliver: Merged and tagged v7.1.1. Kicking low-ramp rollout.

deploy-bot: Detected v7.1.1; starting staged rollout under policy `night-slow-ramp`. Monitoring startup errors and p95.

ops-jen: Watching dashboards; kill-switch ready.

deploy-bot: 5% -> 25% -> 60% healthy.

maya: Promoting to 100%.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100% v7.1.1. No regressions in 30m window. Marking release stable.

oliver: Postmortem action: add a CI preflight that validates flags in changelog against the built binary (ticket RN-156). Closing thread.
